# Preview case folders

<!-- Generated by deployments/tools/prepare-cases.ts --network preview; do not edit. -->

Each folder holds `case.json` (one `mip0018` command per step, the exit code each must end with, the re-check list), `expected.json` (what the reference consumer must conclude, computed from the examples' metadata.json / the vectors) and `expect/*.json` (what `check-event` must find per transaction), plus the run record and the observations; `mip0018 recheck --network preview --case <folder>` re-checks a case wallet-free.

| Case | What | Expected conclusion | Steps | Transactions |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| [C01](C01/README.md) | OpenZeppelin FungibleToken (kind 3): deploy, publish | 1 kind-3 identity with 3 usable fields (name "Acme Gold", symbol "AGLD", decimals 6); no standards; no color. | 4 | 2 |
| [C02](C02/README.md) | OpenZeppelin NativeShieldedToken (kind 1): deploy, mint, publish | 1 kind-1 identity ("Acme Shield", "ASHD", 6) with a color equal to the minted coin color. | 6 | 3 |
| [C03](C03/README.md) | Native unshielded token (kind 2; std-lib mintUnshieldedToken + OpenZeppelin Ownable): deploy, mint to wallet 1, publish | 1 kind-2 identity ("Acme Public", "APUB", 6) whose color is the token type of the UTXO wallet 1 received. | 6 | 3 |
| [C04](C04/README.md) | One asset in kinds 1, 2, 3 (OpenZeppelin NativeShieldedToken + FungibleToken, std-lib unshielded): deploy, three mints, publish | 3 identities ("Acme Dollar", "ACD", 2) in ONE group "ACD"; kinds 1 and 2 colored (same color), kind 3 not. | 8 | 5 |
| [C05](C05/README.md) | OpenZeppelin NativeShieldedTokenFamily: deploy, mint gold + silver, publish three domains | 3 kind-1 identities ("Acme Medals", "MEDAL", 0), one per domain, in one group "MEDAL"; three distinct colors. | 11 | 6 |
